'''Bradel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Bradel was in contact with [[Katei Elinari Panteer]], who was one of the surviving [[House Panteer|Panteers]].<ref name="Sudden Death" /> During this time, he and Katei tasked a Republic agent to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] [[Bouris Ulgo]], though Bradel urged for the usurper to be apprehended for a trial.<ref name="Usurper">{{TORcite|type=general|Usurper|Alderaan}}</ref>
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bradel is a character from the [[Star Wars video games|massively multi-player online role playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Sudden Death" />
